classification: Registered successor protocols; retrospective diagnostics explicitly separate

interval.method: Horizon-specific recency-weighted signed-residual quantiles around persistence
interval.effective_lead: Target date minus last input date
interval.quantile_method: Weighted inverse empirical CDF; no post-hoc repair
interval.guarantee: Empirical intervals only; no exchangeability or population coverage guarantee
interval.amendment_before_any_evaluation: Avoid duplicating the existing unweighted horizon-specific empirical baseline; no result from this new experiment has been viewed.
interval.diagnostic_classification: Training-period retrospective descriptive check on independent licensed context; no parameter selection from this check

learning.rationale: Engineering diversity gates, not a power calculation
learning.selection: Development loss then earlier update; no evaluation-driven selection
learning.reward: For subsequent RL: negative matured training-only terminal pinball / frozen training scale, clipped [-5,5]; four sampled trajectories per task with a group mean baseline
learning.resume: Exact optimizer and RNG prefix only; otherwise a new run
learning.release_gate: No updates until readiness passes; no automatic RL launch

evidence.selection: Greedy categorical decisions, no model updates
evidence.packet_format: Fixed fields and character budget; numerical feedback identical
evidence.final_chooser: True matured validation in every arm
evidence.historical_scope: Retrospective runs labeled as such; forward tasks use evidence retrieved before issuance
evidence.outcomes: pending matched forward tasks; no causal accuracy claim from current open-period prompt shifts
evidence.past_dev: Authorship, IDs, recall results and actual use required; failed recalls recorded
evidence.feedback_hidden_definition: Hide validation scores only; preserve history statistics, tested IDs, denominators and budget. Final chooser retains true validation.

resource_authorization: User authorizes service usage without balance checks; finite job ceilings ensure reproducibility and recovery, not a spending target
